launches.title: Melty Gym: Programmable games for RL and evals
launches.tagline: Turn games into environments for robotics and multi-agent collaboration.
launches.body:
Hi YC! I’m David, founder of Melty. I left high school at 18 to build an AI coach for gamers. It reached 100K users before it was banned for being too OP.

Melty’s AI engine decompiles and reworks games, enabling anyone to combine worlds, change mechanics and add massive multiplayer. So far, gamers have created 3.5K mashups on Melty, played by 170K players.

## Melty Gym

We’re building Melty Gym so researchers can drop their own models and robots into custom games, then adjust the mechanics, objectives and team dynamics to fit their needs.

Games already challenge players to plan many steps ahead, master complex mechanics and coordinate a team. We build on them to quickly create custom training tasks for spatial reasoning and multi-agent collaboration.

![](/media/?type=post&id=128653&key=user_uploads/3401761/40507595-9646-4867-9eb5-ccd4ab5ad372)

_Humanoid robots gather and drive in GTA V, then work at server racks in a custom data center._

[Watch launch video](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1dVUW6HobTEM37kI9BhO-VE-DeEO1RLZq).

## Melty Net

Add 256-player multiplayer to games, mods, and mashups.

![](/media/?type=post&id=128653&key=user_uploads/3401761/2be18fe1-8516-41fb-9ef1-c7bf2512418a)

[Watch the full demo on X](https://x.com/davidmilr/status/2114439421047021907).

## Melty MCP

Create custom games with a single prompt to your coding agent.

![](/media/?type=post&id=128653&key=user_uploads/3401761/d7c63839-5054-46f7-be97-b277ad035bb0)

[Watch the full demo on X](https://x.com/davidmilr/status/2109357152372465823).

## Melty Chat

Create and customize games by chatting with Melty.

![](/media/?type=post&id=128653&key=user_uploads/3401761/2fd3d799-dca8-4556-a873-8dcd197d3ec6)

[Watch the full demo on X](https://x.com/davidmilr/status/2110446996305698971).

## Melty Mashups

Combine games you already own into new ones.

![](/media/?type=post&id=128653&key=user_uploads/3401761/fe00b903-972f-4efd-96dd-fc48530dc723)

[Watch original launch video](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1ILaJ40swpbafdZJdtIby7RfzLcS1LYhk) · [View launch tweet](https://x.com/davidmilr/status/2106802998236078564).

We’re already building custom training tasks with teams.

**If you need custom environments for RL or evals, reach out.**
